_comment: Which countries count as neighbours for a Learn article's related cards (render_cluster_related in build_site.py): after the same country's rules, its calculator, guide and overview, the cards are filled with the same kind of rule in the same region. Each list runs roughly in geographic order, and nearer countries come first. Codes are the app's flag codes; US states are US-XX. A country missing here only gets neighbours from its own country.
